l = [9]

name: parameter alias mutation preserved
code:

    x.append(2)
a = [1]
f(a)
print(a)

name: nested local shadows outer name
code:
def outer():
    x = [9]
    def inner():
        x = [1]
        x.append(2)
        return x
    print(inner(), x)
outer()

name: explicit global mutation preserved
code:
a = [1]
def f():
    global a
    a.append(2)
f()
print(a)

name: nested generators interleaved
code:
def nums(n):
    yield n
    yield n + 1
def outer():
    a = nums(1)
    b = nums(10)
    yield next(a)
    yield next(b)
    yield next(a)
    yield next(b)
print(list(outer()))
